network_status.network: Nubifragio a Trivento: crolla ponte, scene drammatiche
network_status.summary_it: La fonte identifica il cedimento durante il nubifragio di Trivento e l'azione del Rivo, ma non pubblica una stazione, un livello o una portata dell'evento. ARCUS mostra la dinamica descritta e lascia l'idrometria non disponibile.
network_status.summary_en: The source identifies failure during the Trivento cloudburst and action of the Rivo stream but publishes no event station, stage or discharge. ARCUS shows the described process and leaves hydrometry unavailable.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
